text:
Type: trellis woven throw cushion
Use: accent seating comfort, on a sofa or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, traditional, contemporary
Materials: woven jacquard fabric, stitched texture
Colors: cool slate grey, light beige
Shape: square, all-over Moroccan trellis and quatrefoil pattern, fine dotted stitching, knife edges, large
Feel: tailored, calm, classic
Goes with: grey or white sofas, chrome or dark wood, navy accents; modern or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Woven Trellis Modern Decorative Throw Pillow, 20" x 20", Slate Grey
product.description: A classic trellis design with a subtle geometric update, along with neutral colors of slate and ivory, make this pillow a standout in a traditional or modern bedroom. For a different look, reverse it to the solid flax-colored side. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
